name: @ocs/web
//scripts: --webpack is not inertia. Next 16 defaults to Turbopack, and Turbopack does not bundle `new Worker(new URL('./compute.worker.ts', import.meta.url))` under `output: "export"` — it emits the raw .ts as a static asset under _next/static/media, which the browser cannot parse. The worker then fails to start, file-compute.ts silently falls back to the main thread, and hashing a large file locks the UI. Webpack compiles it into a real chunk. Both dev and build use it so the two behave identically; re-test the emitted chunk before switching back.
//pages: build:pages is the GitHub Pages build. It differs from `build` in exactly one thing -- NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH -- because a Pages project site is served from /CipherWorkbench/ while the Electron shell serves the same out/ directory from app://bundle/ with no prefix. cross-env rather than a bare assignment: PowerShell and cmd do not accept `VAR=x cmd`, and this repo's Windows scripts are the primary way it gets built.
